findings.finding: A publication decision requires the evidence, House model, valuation, 40-page PDF and R0–R3 closures to use the same 2026-07-23 price date.
findings.repair: Final materials use CNY17.75, 11.5256252 hundred-million shares, a CNY17.0 displayed target and the same H1 validation boundary. The independent visual/exhibit review is clean and final automated gates are recorded in the sign-off.

findings.finding: The most important uncertainty is whether H1 profit converts to cash and supports H2 unit economics, not a missing report section.
findings.repair: Kept the report publishable with a medium-low model confidence, 30% bear probability, 0% external-target weight and explicit formal-H1 reassessment actions.
